title: Sets in Python
description: Learn to work effectively with Python sets: define set objects, explore the supported operations, and know when sets fit your code.
summary: Python provides a built-in set data type. It differs from other built-in data types in that it’s an unordered collection of unique elements.
takeaways: You’ll receive a score upon completion to help you track your learning progress: Interactive Quiz Python Sets In this quiz, you'll assess your understanding of Python's built-in set data type.
